Primo Calendarum Maij conspecta fuit classis
Anglica in aestuario Forthae (qui Ptolomeo & antiquis
geographis est Bodotria, Lothianam provinciam a Fifa
dirimens) in qua erant 28 naves, & praeter classia-

gno apparatu bellico & ingenti pecuniae summa ad
colligendum aere militem, ubi descensum in terram

praefuit; hisque copiis colligendis praefuturi fuerant
nobiles quidam Scoti, & alii ductores bellici, qui
regiarum partium erant, & qui eadem classe ve-

The name "Ihonstonum" and the place name "Fifa" are uncertain in the scan. The final word on the page is broken at the line end as "conjun-" / "xerant,", which I have joined with the printed hyphen.
